# Op

A single tool-native command a target composes (long form: operation); the
middle of the work hierarchy (Spell to Op to Target).

## Example

A target calls a spell's op by name; this one runs the Go spell's `go-run`.

```buzz
go["go-run"](ctx, {"args": ["./cmd/tool"]});
```
